sloka: स लक्ष्मणस्य उत्तम पुष्कलम् वचो ।निशम्य च एवम् वन वासम् आदरात् ।समाः समस्ता विदधे परम् तपः ।प्रपद्य धर्मम् सुचिराय राघवः ॥२-५३-३४॥
transliteration: sa lakṣmaṇasya uttama puṣkalam vaco ।niśamya ca evam vana vāsam ādarāt ।samāḥ samastā vidadhe param tapaḥ ।prapadya dharmam sucirāya rāghavaḥ ॥2-53-34॥

translations.english: Rama, the tormentor of enemies, listened, out of love, to the excellent and copious words of Lakshmana and permitted him to live in the forest for the entire period of fourteen years by observing the prescribed code of conduct as enjoined on life in the forest.
